selection: 40 matched excerpts from three works. Curated preference pilot, not a representative literary benchmark.
blinding: Source identities are hidden in the interface until a choice, not technically secret in a public static repository. The ten new Black Cat excerpts use AI variants produced in one shared context containing the historical translation; their generation was not blind or independent.
reasoning_effort: medium for the earlier v3 baseline and skill outputs; not recorded for the ten added items
baseline_prompt: Earlier 30: Translate the entries in translation-input.json into Russian. Return an array of {id,text}. Do not read other files or use additional translation tools.
skilled_prompt: Earlier 30: Read translation-input.json and literary-translation-craft/SKILL.md and its references. Produce complete literary Russian translations, preserving voice, viewpoint, rhythm, uncertainty, and repetitions. Do not read baseline or published translations.
new_items_method: Ten Black Cat items: all three AI variants were written by the same model in a single shared conversation after the original and published translation had been read. The brief-request and skill labels describe drafting approaches only; their conditions are not isolated.
operational_note: Prompts above describe their semantic content; local output paths and operational write instructions are omitted. Agent-host behavior is not fully controlled.
reviewed_prompt: For v4, GPT-6.1 Terra read the stories, prepared an editorial brief and separately reviewed all 30 earlier outputs against source excerpts; eight changes were recorded. Ten additional excerpts were then drafted and checked in the same shared context. This is model-assisted self-review, not human proofreading or multi-model routing.
human_condition: Historical published translations with rights/source notes per excerpt; age, edition and transcription may affect preference.
interpretation: Preference for these particular outputs only. The ten new excerpts have unblinded, non-independent AI variants and cannot establish a controlled comparison.
